Colour encodings

The following examples specify the four bytes of the colour information chunk. Each example is part of this specification and provides an encoding that implementers can compare against their own output.

Full-range BT.2100 PQ uses this encoding:

09 10 00 01

Full-range BT.2100 HLG uses this encoding:

09 12 00 01

Narrow-range BT.709 uses this encoding:

01 01 00 00

Full-range Display-P3 uses this encoding:

0C 0D 00 01

Decoders use the colour information to interpret the image samples. The field order is significant, and each byte must retain the value shown in the corresponding example.
